{"addr": "0x1406cc950", "comment": "Actor::EndDeferredKill(actor, aScripted) -> ActorProcess::EndDeferredKill 40036. Every engine caller passes aScripted 0 (Set3D, MoveToLow, MoveToMiddleLow, Revert, 37947, 37972, KillActorHandler 42838, FlightLandEndHandler, 42907, 140686420); only papyrus EndDeferredKill passes 1. So a copy's scripted hold (UpdateCopyAI) is never ended by the engine: it lives until its MiddleHigh process data goes. SkyrimCoop piece-4b (read 2026-11-20)."}

A sequence idle (flag 2) goes through coop_NextSequenceIdle. One pick, no retry. SkyrimCoop piece-4b"}

{"addr": "0x1407ae440", "comment": "42350: the player's action from controls (AttackBlockHandler 42435: 45, ...). For attack actions picks a swing target in reach (Actor_PickSwingTarget). First try: Func5 41557 with that target (the idle tree may pick a pa_KillMove; StartPair 32803 may refuse it). Refused with a target: SECOND TRY in the same call: event and target event set empty, target cleared (BGSActionData_SetTarget null), flags &~3, Func5 again -> the tree picks with no target: a normal swing. This is vanilla's fallback for a refused pair. SkyrimCoop piece-4b (read 2026-11-20)"}

Records the killer's handle (Actor+0x108) and queues the kill (task 10: KillImpl), unless one is queued already (MiddleHigh killQueued 0x331, 40011). KillActorHandler 42838 calls it with the pair partner. SkyrimCoop piece-4b: re-read 2026-11-20"}

{"addr": "0x1407285a0", "comment": "ActorProcess::StartDeferredKill 40033: one hold per actor. State (MiddleHigh +0x2F8) to 1 if 0; the scripted flag (+0x332) is OR'd with a2, so a non-scripted start (EnterKillMove 38613) never clears a scripted hold; +0x2D4 a timer from a setting. So an NPC lent for a claimed pair (scripted hold kept from its time as a copy) keeps it through its kill move: KillActorHandler's EndDeferredKill(0) does not match. SkyrimCoop piece-4b (read 2026-11-20)"}
